prompt: Looking down from high on the far hillside across the whole valley of the downs, the place in the first image seen from a long way off: the bunker mound with its plain shut green doors in the upper left; the smoking kill-bot wreck as a black shape on the grass to the right; and the tiny grey robot from the second image on a faint wheel track heading away from the bunker down the slope, keeping to the left of the wreck, her amber beacon a pinprick of warm light and her thin hooped aerial up, as in the third image. Lines of old field boundaries, wind on the grass, a heavy grey sky. Shot like a 1980s BBC drama on 16mm stock, washed-out colour, gentle contrast, thick grain. Widescreen, no lettering.
